bienvenida.title: WELCOME TO SAN ISIDRO
bienvenida.p1: We know that choosing a school for your children is probably one of the most important decisions you will face as parents. It means choosing the place that will accompany them through a key stage of their lives, where they will learn, grow, discover their talents and build bonds that leave a lasting mark.
bienvenida.p2: We know you are entrusting us with the most valuable thing you have. That is why we are committed to accompanying, caring for and educating every student in an environment of love, respect and joy, within a holistic, bilingual and Catholic-oriented education, sustained by high academic standards.
bienvenida.p3: We invite you to get to know our educational project and to discover what it means to be part of a community that grows, learns and transforms together.

pilares.intro: We believe that educating is much more than teaching. It means accompanying every student in discovering who they are and everything they can become, integrating every dimension of their growth into an education that leaves a lasting mark.

propuesta.title: Discover our proposal
propuesta.subtitle: Explore the different programmes and experiences that are part of life at our school.

niveles.title: Academic levels
niveles.description: We accompany our students at every stage of their growth, from their very first learning experiences to their preparation for the challenges of the future.

experiencia.title: SIC Experience
experiencia.description: Wellbeing, innovation, art and new ways of learning come together in experiences that allow every student to discover their interests and develop their abilities.

deportes.title: Sports
deportes.description: Sport shapes, unites and teaches. Through every discipline, our students learn to challenge themselves, work as a team and grow as part of a community.

conocernos.title: We invite you to get to know us
conocernos.p1: Getting to know a school also means walking through its spaces, talking with the people who are part of it and imagining your children growing, learning and building their own story there.
conocernos.p2: We invite you to discover San Isidro College, learn about our educational project and find answers to all your questions.

introduccion.p1: San Isidro College opened its doors in 2016 with the purpose of offering the community of Salta a demanding and ambitious educational project, oriented towards a holistic, bilingual and Catholic education. Our proposal combines the contents established by the national education system with international programmes of high academic standards.
introduccion.p2: Bilingualism is part of our students' everyday experience. From the earliest years, English is incorporated intensively and naturally across different subjects, activities and learning experiences. In this way, every student progressively develops comprehension and oral expression, and gains the confidence needed to communicate in both languages.
introduccion.p3: Our proposal goes beyond the classroom. In a privileged natural setting, we create spaces for learning, meeting and participation through academic, cultural, recreational and sporting activities that foster the personal, intellectual, emotional and spiritual development of our students.
introduccion.p4: San Isidro College was conceived and developed with the support of specialised professionals and advisors from Salta, Buenos Aires and abroad. This outlook is enriched by international programmes, certifications and links with educational institutions that broaden learning opportunities and connect our students with the world.

mision.label: Mission
mision.texto: To educate global citizens through a holistic, bilingual and Catholic-oriented education that supports the personal, intellectual, emotional and spiritual growth of every student.

vision.label: Vision
vision.texto: To educate resilient and creative people, able to recognise opportunities, face new challenges, contribute to the progress of society and act with autonomy, responsibility and confidence in a constantly changing world.

escudo.title: Our crest, our identity
escudo.intro: Our crest tells who we are and what we believe in. Each of its symbols expresses a part of our identity and reminds us that educating also means sowing with love, accompanying with patience and trusting in the fruits that every student can bear.

aprendizajeValores.title: Learning through values
aprendizajeValores.p1: One of the fundamental goals of San Isidro College is to work as a team with the professionals who make up our community in order to educate free, creative, autonomous, responsible, honest and supportive students; with critical thinking, deep ethical and Christian values, able to face everyday challenges and committed to their own life project.
aprendizajeValores.p2: We seek to educate people who are aware of their duties and rights, proud of their history and their roots, respectful of their values and traditions and, at the same time, open to the world and able to understand and respect other cultures.
aprendizajeValores.p3: We work on learning through values in a systematic and planned way, as a cross-cutting theme that sustains the bonds of the whole school community. We believe values are not merely stated: they must be practised and expressed through everyday example. School is one of the privileged spaces to develop them through daily experiences and the constant support of our teachers.
aprendizajeValores.p4: Empathy and self-control translate into respect, solidarity, love for others and temperance. These learnings allow our students to build better relationships, strengthen their bonds, make friends and work as a team. We strive for kindness to be present in every interaction and for every member of our community to feel respected and valued.

educacionPersonalizada.title: Personalised education
educacionPersonalizada.p1: We believe that every student is unique: they have their own story, interests and talents, and a particular way of learning and relating to the world. That is why our educational proposal starts from knowing and listening to each person, in order to accompany them in discovering and developing their abilities.
educacionPersonalizada.p2: A student who feels heard, valued and emotionally supported gains greater confidence to participate, create, raise questions and dare to produce. They learn how to learn, because they understand that knowledge is built, expands and opens the door to new learning.
educacionPersonalizada.p3: Personalised education does not mean lowering expectations, but offering every student the tools and support they need to take an active role in their learning. Our teachers guide that process, progressively encourage autonomy and create opportunities to move forward and take on new challenges.
educacionPersonalizada.p4: We want every student to find the pleasure of coming to school, learning, meeting others and discovering different ways of expressing themselves through knowledge, sport and art. Along this path, the close bond between school and family is essential to accompany each stage of their growth consistently.
educacionPersonalizada.alt1: A San Isidro College teacher supporting her students
educacionPersonalizada.alt2: A San Isidro College teacher in the classroom

instalaciones.title: A school designed to be a school
instalaciones.videoAlt: Video of the San Isidro College facilities
instalaciones.p1: From the very beginning, every space at San Isidro College was designed to support school life. The layout, the classrooms, the furniture and the common areas were planned especially to favour learning, meeting, wellbeing and the safety of our students.
instalaciones.p2: Since its early days, the school has integrated technology in every classroom through interactive whiteboards and screens that enrich learning experiences and encourage active participation. Classrooms also feature modern, ergonomic furniture with natural light and ventilation, creating comfortable environments suited to each stage of growth.
instalaciones.p3: In Secondary, folding acoustic panels make it possible to expand or reorganise classrooms according to the needs of each activity, favouring flexible and collaborative learning experiences.
instalaciones.p4: The school is surrounded by large green areas that connect students with nature and offer different environments to learn, share, play and practise sports. It also has solar panels that harness a renewable energy source and reflect our commitment to caring for the environment and building a more sustainable community.
instalaciones.p5: Safety is also part of the design of our facilities. The different areas have emergency exits and doors that allow an orderly and safe evacuation whenever necessary.

intro.p1: At San Isidro College, English is not learned only as a subject: it becomes part of everyday life through a comprehensive bilingual project. Our purpose is for students to develop solid competence in both Spanish and English, and to communicate with understanding, confidence and ease in both languages.
intro.p2: Learning begins in the earliest years and is progressively consolidated throughout Kindergarten, Primary and Secondary. The programme expands gradually according to the age and needs of each student, respecting every stage of their development.
intro.p3: From an early age, our students come into contact with English through familiar and meaningful situations. The process moves from the familiar to the new and from the concrete to the abstract, encouraging the natural acquisition of the sounds, rhythms and forms of expression of the language.
intro.p4: The progressive extension of the school day provides daily, systematic and intensive contact with English, along with many opportunities to listen, understand, read, write and express themselves. This builds a solid bond with the second language and the confidence needed to use it in different situations.
intro.p5: San Isidro College holds official recognition for its Foreign Language Teaching Programme: English, whose subjects are integrated into the extended school day. This recognition from the Ministry of Education endorses a planned, systematic programme aligned with the official curriculum.

aprenderIngles.p1: We believe learning becomes more meaningful when English is presented not only as an object of study, but as a language for accessing other knowledge.
aprenderIngles.p2: Through cross-curricular projects and interdisciplinary work, our students use the language to research, study, carry out activities, solve problems, create and share what they have learned. In this way they do not only learn English: they also learn in English.
aprenderIngles.p3: Graphic and audiovisual resources, reading, oral productions, games, songs, drama, presentations and group work make it possible to use the language in real contexts and for concrete purposes. The arts are also part of this experience, through activities that bring together language, art, music, singing and theatre.
aprenderIngles.p4: This journey is enriched in Secondary with internationally oriented programmes such as Cambridge IGCSE and the Dual Diploma® from Académica, which are described in the section for that level.

propositos.title: Our Purposes
propositos.contacto: To provide daily, systematic and intensive contact with English.
propositos.comprension: To foster comprehension, oral expression, reading and writing.
propositos.idioma: To promote the use of the language in meaningful communicative situations.
propositos.acceso: To use English as a means of accessing other content and learning.
propositos.confianza: To strengthen confidence and autonomy in communication.
propositos.articular: To connect the foreign language with the different areas of the curriculum.
propositos.culturas: To broaden the understanding of other cultures and ways of seeing the world.
propositos.herramientas: To provide tools for academic, social and professional contexts that are increasingly global.

intro.title: Kindergarten
intro.subtitle: Learning through play, growing in two languages
intro.p1: Kindergarten is the beginning of a stage full of discovery. In a close, safe and caring environment, we accompany our children so that they can explore, imagine, create, express themselves and build their first bonds with others and with learning.
intro.p2: Our programme supports personal, intellectual, emotional, social, psychomotor and creative development, respecting the pace, interests and needs of each age. The close bond with their teachers gives every student the confidence to take part, discover and learn.

ingles.p1: Our bilingual project begins in K2 and continues progressively through K3, K4 and K5. From the earliest years, students are in contact with Spanish and English through everyday experiences inside and outside the classroom.
ingles.p2: At this stage we seek to strengthen the development of the mother tongue and to encourage the early incorporation of English as a second language. The process starts from what is known and familiar to them and moves towards new words, sounds and forms of expression.
ingles.p3: Songs, stories, puppets, rhymes, games, role play, phrases and instructions allow English to appear in meaningful, familiar situations. In this way, students begin to use it as a tool for communication and as a language through which they can also access other learning.

juego.title: The value of play
juego.p1: From K2 onwards, play is the cornerstone of our programme. It is a spontaneous, natural activity that brings us closer to the interests, needs and thought processes of each student.
juego.p2: What comes naturally to children is learning through play. Through play they get to know the world around them, test their ideas, try out different roles, develop skills and abilities, create their own meanings and find new ways of solving situations.
juego.p3: Play also allows them to meet others, share experiences, collaborate, learn to wait, understand different points of view and strengthen values such as empathy and respect. In this way, play contributes to psychomotor, cognitive, social, emotional and moral development.
juego.p4: The foundation and driving force of all deep learning is the affective bond. When students feel supported and safe, they trust their own abilities, enjoy the process and are more open to exploring and learning. Because it is playful and motivating, play makes it possible to create, imagine, develop fantasy and come naturally closer to language, art, problem solving and learning in both languages.

intro.title: Primary
intro.subtitle: Learning, discovering and growing in two languages
intro.p1: During this stage we accompany our students so that they consolidate the learning begun in Kindergarten, discover their talents and progressively develop their independence, their sense of responsibility and confidence in their own abilities.
intro.p2: Our programme brings together the areas established by the Jurisdictional Curriculum Design and the Foreign Language Teaching Programme: English. In this way, students broaden their knowledge and develop the skills to understand, express themselves and learn in both languages.
intro.p3: We encourage an attitude of effort, work and responsibility towards study, together with curiosity and an interest in learning. We want every student to recognise their own possibilities, take on new challenges and build genuinely meaningful learning.

propuesta.p1: The syllabus integrates the official curriculum areas —Language, Mathematics, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Technology, Ethics and Citizenship, Physical Education, Art and Religious Education— with different subjects taught in English.
propuesta.p2: The English programme comprises Language, with areas such as Comprehension, Oral Language, Reading, Written Language, Creative Writing and Spelling, as well as Literature, Social Studies, Science and Drama.
propuesta.p3: This integration means that English is not only a subject, but also a language for reading, researching, creating, studying and sharing what has been learned. Through daily, intensive contact, we foster a broad understanding of the language and the progressive development of expression and communication.

literatura.title: Literature as a starting point
literatura.p1: Our methodology finds one of its main starting points in literature. Reading broadens language, stimulates the imagination, introduces other realities and opens up space to talk, interpret, ask questions and express ideas.
literatura.p2: We set out to turn the classroom into a community of readers and writers, where every student can develop their own possibilities and grow as an interpreter and producer of texts in both languages.
literatura.frase: You learn to read by reading and to write by writing.
literatura.p3: Through carefully selected works and reading activities, students develop comprehension, oral expression, writing and critical thinking, while enriching their sensitivity, their creativity and the way they understand the world.

aprendizajes.title: Meaningful learning
aprendizajes.p1: During the first years of Primary, play continues to be a valuable learning strategy and progressively evolves into activities, projects and challenges suited to each age.
aprendizajes.p2: Our programme addresses intellectual, emotional, social, psychomotor and creative development.
aprendizajes.p3: We encourage curiosity, independent thinking, moral awareness and the enjoyment of beauty, creating opportunities for students to explore, express themselves, connect knowledge and find meaning in what they learn.

ejes.title: Cross-curricular themes
ejes.description: These themes run through the different areas and guide the development of fundamental skills throughout the whole stage.

comunicativa.title: Communicative competence
comunicativa.backText: We want students to be able to read with understanding, produce and analyse verbal and non-verbal messages, and obtain, select, organise and interpret information for different purposes and in both languages.

cientifica.title: Scientific and technological literacy
cientifica.backText: Teaching science means offering new ways of observing, questioning and understanding the world. We start from familiar situations and phenomena to accompany students in the progressive construction of scientific explanations and models.

problemas.title: Problem solving
problemas.backText: In school life as much as in everyday life, students need to learn to identify, understand and explain problems, imagine possible strategies and weigh up different alternatives. We foster the ability to make well-founded decisions, compare procedures and results, and develop logical, critical, reflective and creative thinking.

ciudadana.title: Personal, social and global citizenship education
ciudadana.backText: We accompany our students so that they learn to relate to themselves, to others and to the community. We promote the values that sustain living together, respect for rights and duties, and responsible participation. We seek to form empathetic, critical and committed citizens, able to work alongside others and contribute positively to the transformation of society in an interconnected world.

sustentabilidad.title: Education for Sustainability
sustentabilidad.backText: Through sustainable initiatives and practices and environmental projects, students come to understand the importance of acting responsibly.

recorrido.title: A journey that continues
recorrido.description: Throughout Primary, the programme gradually increases the complexity of the content, the use of English and the independence of the students. The articulation between the different years and with Secondary gives continuity to their learning and supports a natural, secure transition to the next stage.

cuadro.title: A journey from 1st Form to 7th Form

intro.title: Secondary
intro.subtitle: An academic programme with an international outlook
intro.p1: Throughout the five years of Secondary, we offer a comprehensive bilingual education on a full-day schedule from Monday to Friday. Our programme brings together the official Argentine curriculum with international programmes and innovative learning experiences that broaden our students' outlook and prepare them to act as committed leaders and global citizens in an increasingly connected world.
intro.p2: We foster a demanding academic education, centred on the student and directed towards the development of independence, critical thinking, creativity and the ability to make decisions. We want every young person to recognise their interests and abilities, take on new challenges and progressively build their own path.

orientaciones.title: Two orientations, different paths
orientaciones.p1: In the last three years of Secondary, students can choose between two orientations that allow them to deepen their knowledge according to their interests and future plans.
orientaciones.p2: Both orientations strengthen the ability to research, solve problems, work as a team and apply knowledge in concrete situations.

naturales.label: Natural Sciences
naturales.p1: This orientation fosters curiosity, scientific research and commitment to the environment. Working in a fully equipped laboratory, students can observe, experiment, analyse phenomena and establish links between theoretical knowledge and its applications in the real world.

informatica.label: Computer Science
informatica.p1: The Computer Science orientation sets out to move from using technology to understanding and creating it. Students develop digital solutions, explore the possibilities of artificial intelligence and build prototypes that bring together programming, engineering and electronics.

mundo.title: An education connected to the world
mundo.p1: The bilingual journey takes on a new depth in Secondary. Students broaden their ability to study, research, produce and communicate in English, and gain access to programmes that connect their education with international educational standards.

igcse.label: Cambridge IGCSE
igcse.p1: The Cambridge IGCSE programme allows our students to prepare for international certifications in different areas. Its approach fosters a deep understanding of the content, research, problem solving, critical thinking and the ability to communicate academically in English.
igcse.p2: The certifications obtained accredit the knowledge and skills developed in each subject within an internationally recognised framework.

dual.p1: From 2nd year onwards, students may choose to take Academica's Dual Diploma®. The programme is delivered online with native-speaking teachers and allows them to study for their Argentine secondary qualification and the subjects required for the American High School Diploma at the same time.
dual.p2: The experience strengthens their English, independence, organisation and command of digital environments, while introducing them to another educational culture and widening their future academic possibilities.

proyectoVida.title: Building a life project of one's own
proyectoVida.p1: We understand that Secondary is a fundamental stage for getting to know oneself, discovering interests, recognising strengths and beginning to make decisions about the future.
proyectoVida.p2: Our aim is that every student graduates with a solid, conscious and independent life project. To that end, we accompany each young person with a programme that combines academic demand, innovation, opportunities to explore and the human closeness needed to grow in confidence.
proyectoVida.p3: We do not expect them to have all the answers at the end of this stage, but to have the tools, the values and the confidence they need to keep building their own path.

formacion.title: An education that goes beyond the classroom
formacion.description: A comprehensive education is also built through experiences that make it possible to create, take part, care, express oneself and grow alongside others.

persona.title: The Heart of Our Project: The Person
persona.backText: Our premise is clear: the person comes first. We prioritize student well-being and the development of an inclusive community where each learner feels valued. We seek integral growth, shaping young people with open minds and deep sensitivity to sustainability and social impact.

ciudadania.title: Global citizenship
ciudadania.backText: Through strong bilingual education, we prepare our students to thrive in an interconnected world. Our academic excellence strengthens teamwork as an essential 21st-century skill, curiosity to discover the world, critical thinking, and creativity to build an ethical life project.

innovacion.title: Innovation and Leading-Edge Technology
innovacion.backText: Real innovation: students build their own prototypes from scratch (without commercial kits), integrating engineering and electronics. Artificial intelligence: advanced projects to lead in digital environments. Infrastructure: classrooms with interactive touch screens and a fully equipped high-complexity lab.

deportes.title: Sports
deportes.backText: Sports and healthy living: discipline and teamwork through Rugby, Hockey, and Jiu-Jitsu. With our own gym and tournament participation, we promote values such as respect, effort, solidarity, and enjoyment, while developing motor skills. Throughout the year, students join matches, tours, and competitions with other clubs, strengthening friendship, discipline, and belonging.

artes.title: The Arts
artes.backText: The transformative power of art is a fundamental pillar for sensitivity and self-expression. Through different artistic languages, students develop new forms of communication, strengthening emotional intelligence, creativity, and abstract thinking. Art becomes a space of freedom that drives innovation and personal confidence.

sustentabilidad.title: Sustainability and social commitment
sustentabilidad.backText: Sustainability is not just a concept, but a way of inhabiting the world. We educate young people with deep environmental and social awareness, capable of leading projects that create a positive impact in their surroundings. Through an ethical and responsible perspective, we integrate respect for nature and social equity, preparing global citizens committed to caring for our common home and future generations.

hero.description: With various graphic and audiovisual resources, group and expression dynamics, exhibitions, games, dramatizations, songs, stories, etc., the expressive and productive stage is continuously strengthened, consolidated, and nourished.

kinder.title: KINDERGARTEN
kinder.p1: Our Bilingual Project starts in the nursery, K2, so that children are exposed to both languages throughout the day. The process continues in K3, K4, and K5.
kinder.p2: One of our objectives at this stage is to strengthen the mother tongue and work on the early acquisition of English as a second language.
kinder.p3: Furthermore, it promotes curricular articulation with the primary level, facilitating a natural and safe transition.
kinder.mobileBrief: Our Bilingual Project starts in the nursery, K2, …

primary.title: PRIMARY
primary.p1: With a Bilingual Proposal, we work so that children can discover their talents and abilities. As a school prepared and advised by experienced professionals, we guarantee a natural incorporation of the English language as a second language. Thus, each student achieves broad language comprehension and expressive and communication skills.

secondary.title: SECONDARY
secondary.subtitle: Leaders of the future
secondary.p1: We prioritize a student-centered approach to develop key 21st-century skills such as autonomy, critical thinking, and creativity. With a solid bilingual foundation, we prepare our students for international exams and advanced technical English proficiency, tailored to their fields of study. We provide a space where learning comes to life.
secondary.dualText: Our students independently pursue the dual United States High School Diploma. This option gives them a competitive edge, allowing them to obtain both an Argentine and a U.S. high school diploma simultaneously, expanding their academic and professional opportunities internationally.

hero.title: Sports
hero.description: San Isidro College, located in a privileged natural environment, develops a varied Physical Education program. As part of our Pedagogical Project, we aim to contribute to shaping a life plan.

rugbyHockey.title: RUGBY & HOCKEY CLUB
rugbyHockey.description: School and Club united, building and sowing values that transcend the field. A strong, committed community for the benefit of our students.

dojo.title: SAN ISIDRO COLLEGE DOJO
dojo.description: The San Isidro Dojo is the place where our students develop discipline, respect, and strength through judo. As part of our comprehensive education, we promote essential values and encourage physical and emotional growth in an atmosphere of camaraderie and dedication. A place to learn, grow, and excel every day!
dojo.descriptionMobile: We develop discipline, respect, and strength through judo, promoting essential values in an environment of camaraderie and effort.

gym.title: SAN ISIDRO BALANCE
gym.description:
San Isidro Balance is a comprehensive training and wellness space designed to support the school’s students and also open to parents and teachers who want to reach their full physical potential. 

 Here we combine high-quality training, specific physical conditioning, skill work, and nutritional support, integrating everything a modern gym offers within a professional and well-cared-for program. Each activity is designed to enhance performance, prevent injuries, and promote healthy habits. 

 San Isidro Balance is movement, balance, and evolution.
gym.descriptionMobile: San Isidro Balance is a comprehensive training and wellness space designed to support the school’s students and also open to parents and teachers who want to reach their full physical potential.

vida.title: STUDENT LIFE
vida.description: San Isidro College fosters a positive and dynamic environment where students can fully develop, guided by core values. We prepare our students for the 21st century by teaching them how to manage stress, be resilient, and be test-ready, with the support of the Student Services Department and tutoring.

hero.title: San Isidro Experience
hero.description: The experience of growing, learning, and sharing goes far beyond the classroom. At San Isidro College, each activity complements academic development and creates new opportunities to build talents, strengthen bonds, and enjoy a community that inspires growth.

rugbyHockey.title: Wellbeing And Guidance
rugbyHockey.description: We believe every student learns better when they feel safe, heard, and supported. That is why we promote an environment of trust, respect, and closeness, where wellbeing is part of the educational experience every day.

googleReferenceSchool.title: Google Reference School
googleReferenceSchool.description: Innovation has been part of our identity from day one. As a Google Reference School, we integrate technology in meaningful ways to strengthen learning, creativity, and collaboration, preparing our students for the challenges of the future.

innovacionRobotica.title: Innovation and Robotics
innovacionRobotica.description: A space where ideas become projects. Our Innovation and Robotics Lab invites students to explore, design, build, and experiment, developing the skills to solve the challenges of the present and the future.

feYCompromisoSocial.title: Faith and Social Commitment
feYCompromisoSocial.description: Our Catholic orientation supports the human and spiritual growth of our students, fostering a faith expressed through love for others, care for nature, and commitment to the community. Through everyday example and service experiences, we seek to form free and caring people, able to help transform their community.
feYCompromisoSocial.fallbackAlt: Faith and social commitment at San Isidro College

arteYCreatividad.title: Art and Creativity
arteYCreatividad.description:
Art is part of life at San Isidro College and an essential dimension of our integral education. Through Music, Singing, Visual Arts, Theatre, and Body Expression, students develop their sensitivity, discover their talents, and find new ways to communicate and create.

These disciplines come together in collective projects such as San Isidro Play, where art and English meet in an experience shared across all levels.
arteYCreatividad.fallbackAlt: Art and creativity at San Isidro College

houses.title: Houses
houses.description:
We believe education is built far beyond the classroom: in learning, in relationships, in shared challenges, in achievements, and in the values we practise every day.

We do not only want our students to acquire knowledge. We want to support them so they become thoughtful people, confident leaders, and active members committed to their community.

With this vision, the San Isidro College House System is born: a new tradition meant to strengthen belonging, connection, and the participation of all our students.
houses.logosAlt: House logos: Condor House, Owl House and Falcon House

actividadesExtracurriculares.title: Extracurricular Activities
actividadesExtracurriculares.description: Each student has unique talents and interests. That is why our extracurricular activities create spaces where they can express themselves, challenge themselves, and grow. Through proposals such as Dance, Jiu-Jitsu, and Gym, we complement academic education with experiences that strengthen the body, mind, and confidence.

intro.p1: At San Isidro College, we understand that educating means accompanying. Our students' wellbeing is a core pillar of our educational proposal, because feeling supported, safe, and heard is essential to learn, grow, and develop their full potential.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
philosophy.p1: Educating means much more than transmitting knowledge. It means supporting each student at every stage of their growth, helping them develop confidence, autonomy, empathy, and the tools they need to face life's challenges.
philosophy.p2: At San Isidro College, we want every student to find a place where they can learn, grow, and build healthy relationships within a community that knows and supports them.

community.title: A community that supports
community.p1: Wellbeing does not depend on one person or one team alone. It is the result of the commitment of the entire educational community.
community.p2: Teachers, tutors, coordinators, and school leaders work closely to know each student, support their journey, and create a school climate based on respect, trust, and a sense of belonging.

eoe.title:
Professional support
School Guidance Team (EOE)
eoe.p1: In addition to the daily support provided by teachers and tutors, San Isidro College has a School Guidance Team made up of Psychology and Psychopedagogy professionals who support our students' pathways and work in coordination with families, teachers, and, when necessary, external professionals.

closing.title: Supporting growth
closing.p1: At San Isidro College, we understand that each student follows a unique path. That is why we promote a culture of care where wellbeing, closeness, and guidance are part of the educational experience every day. Our commitment is to provide each student with the tools, support, and confidence they need to grow, learn, and develop their full potential.

tutorias.title: Tutoring
tutorias.backText: Each student has a tutor who supports their personal and academic development, encouraging dialogue, close follow-up, and the building of trusting relationships.

educacionEmocional.title: Emotional education
educacionEmocional.backText: We work on skills such as empathy, resilience, communication, conflict resolution, and emotional management to encourage integral development.

trabajoFamilias.title: Working with families
trabajoFamilias.backText: We believe education is a shared task. We maintain close and ongoing communication with families to support each student's growth.

desarrolloIntegral.title: Integral development
desarrolloIntegral.backText: Our goal is to form well-rounded individuals who can learn, live together, make responsible decisions, and face new challenges with confidence.

sostenEmocional.title: Emotional support
sostenEmocional.backText: Spaces for listening, guidance, and containment to support students through the challenges of each stage of their development.

acompanamientoPsicopedagogico.title: Psychopedagogical guidance
acompanamientoPsicopedagogico.backText: Interventions focused on strengthening learning processes, developing study strategies, and enhancing each student's cognitive abilities.

convivenciaEscolar.title: School coexistence
convivenciaEscolar.backText: We promote healthy relationships and support group dynamics to sustain a respectful, inclusive, and positive school climate.

trabajoInterdisciplinario.title: Interdisciplinary work
trabajoInterdisciplinario.backText: The EOE works together with teachers, families, and external professionals to provide the most appropriate support according to each student's needs.

experienciaSicGoogleReferenceSchoolDetai.logoAlt: Google for Education Reference School logo
experienciaSicGoogleReferenceSchoolDetai.title: San Isidro College is a Google Reference School

intro.p1: It is a recognition that distinguishes educational institutions that integrate Google technology in innovative ways to transform teaching and learning.

whatIs.title: What does it mean to be a Google Reference School?
whatIs.p1: Being a Google Reference School means being part of an international community of institutions that stand out for using technology as a tool to strengthen learning, creativity, and collaboration.
whatIs.p2: This recognition reflects our commitment to innovative education, where technology supports the development of essential skills for the present and the future.

students.title: What does it mean for our students?

collaborativeLearning.title: Collaborative learning
collaborativeLearning.description: Students work as a team using digital tools that encourage communication and the shared construction of knowledge.

digitalCitizenship.title: Digital citizenship
digitalCitizenship.description: They learn to use technology in a responsible, ethical, and safe way.

creativeThinking.title: Creativity and innovation
creativeThinking.description: Technology becomes a means to create, investigate, solve problems, and develop new ideas.

futureReady.title: Future readiness
futureReady.description: They develop digital competencies that will be essential in university, the workplace, and the challenges of the 21st century.

teachers.title: What does it mean for our teachers?

enhanceTeaching.title: Enhancing teaching
enhanceTeaching.description: Technology supports teachers' work by offering new tools to enrich every learning experience.

innovateWithConfidence.title: Innovating with confidence
innovateWithConfidence.description: Our teachers receive ongoing training and support to incorporate new methodologies and make the most of digital tools.

collaborateToGrow.title: Collaborating to grow
collaborateToGrow.description: Shared planning and resource exchange strengthen teamwork and promote a professional learning community.

inspireStudents.title: Inspiring students
inspireStudents.description: Innovation begins with prepared teachers who spark curiosity, encourage creativity, and support each student in their development.

technology.title: Technology as part of learning
technology.p1: At San Isidro College, technology does not replace the teacher: it strengthens teaching. Since the school opened, innovation and digital tools have been part of our educational proposal. Google Workspace for Education supports the daily experience of students and teachers, promoting dynamic, collaborative, and organized learning from the earliest years.

closing.p1: At San Isidro College, we believe that innovating does not mean adding more technology, but creating better opportunities to learn. Being a Google Reference School reflects that commitment to an education that prepares our students for the world ahead.

intro.lead: A space where ideas become projects.
intro.p1: At San Isidro College, we believe the best learning experiences happen when students have the opportunity to experiment.
intro.p2: Our Innovation and Robotics Lab is designed to spark curiosity, encourage creativity, and turn ideas into real projects.
intro.p3: Through challenges, hands-on experiences, and collaborative work, students develop skills that go beyond technical knowledge and prepare them for a constantly evolving world.

creativeThinking.title: Creative thinking
creativeThinking.description: They learn to imagine, design, and transform ideas into innovative solutions.

problemSolving.title: Problem solving
problemSolving.description: They analyze challenges, test different alternatives, and find solutions through iteration and continuous improvement.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.description: Each project encourages collaboration, communication, and shared learning.

computationalThinking.title: Computational thinking
computationalThinking.description: They develop programming, logic, and sequencing skills to understand how technology works and create with it.

lab.title: A space to experiment
lab.p1: Our lab brings together different tools and technologies so students can investigate, build, and learn actively.

closing.p1: Our Innovation and Robotics Lab expresses San Isidro College's commitment to innovative education. Together with our technological proposal and our recognition as a Google Reference School, this space encourages students to learn, create, and develop the skills that will allow them to move confidently in the world of tomorrow.

intro.p1: We believe education is built far beyond the classroom: in learning, in relationships, in shared challenges, in achievements, and in the values we practise every day.
intro.p2: We do not only want our students to acquire knowledge. We want to support them so they become thoughtful people, confident leaders, and active members committed to their community.
intro.p3: With this vision, the San Isidro College House System is born: a new tradition meant to strengthen belonging, connection, and the participation of all our students.

comunidad.p1: Houses are much more than teams. They are communities within the school that bring together students from different years and create opportunities to collaborate, take on responsibilities, develop leadership, build friendships, and learn from one another.
comunidad.p2: Each House represents a different quality, but none is more important than the others. Together they express what we want to awaken in our students.

casas.title: Different strengths. One community. One shared purpose.
casas.ariaLabel: The three San Isidro College Houses

condor.name: Condors
condor.description: The condor invites us to look beyond the horizon, discover new possibilities, and inspire others through our actions.
condor.purpose: To inspire our students to go beyond their own limits, pursue excellence with purpose, and lead others through vision and example.
condor.qualities: Vision · Inspiration · Leadership · Excellence · Purpose · Perspective
condor.symbol1Text: represents guidance, aspiration, and the pursuit of excellence.
condor.symbol2Text: represents direction, purpose, and the ability to find a path forward.

owl.name: Owls
owl.description: The owl reminds us that growth involves listening, asking questions, observing, and learning from every experience to make sound decisions.
owl.purpose: To encourage our students to become lifelong learners, think critically, and lead with understanding and integrity.
owl.qualities: Wisdom · Curiosity · Understanding · Reflection · Knowledge · Integrity
owl.symbol2Text: represents learning, knowledge, communication, and the exchange of ideas.

falcon.name: Falcons
falcon.description: The falcon reminds us that courage means turning vision into action, facing challenges with confidence, and persevering despite fear.
falcon.purpose: To inspire our students to face challenges with courage, act with confidence, and pursue their goals with determination.
falcon.qualities: Courage · Determination · Resilience · Initiative · Confidence · Perseverance
falcon.symbol1Text: represents action, energy, initiative, and determination.
falcon.symbol2Text: represents passion, resilience, and inner strength.

closing.p1: Although each student belongs to a House, they are all part of one community: San Isidro College.
closing.p2: The House System promotes healthy competition, leadership, collaboration, service, and personal growth, while strengthening the values that define our school. Every challenge, every achievement, every act of companionship, and every chance to help others contributes not only to their own House, but to the whole community.

intro.p1: At San Isidro College, art is a fundamental dimension of a well-rounded education. It develops sensitivity, creativity, and the ability to express ideas, emotions, and different ways of looking at the world.
intro.p2: The artistic experience brings together every side of a person. It allows students to discover talents, build confidence, enrich their inner world, and find new ways to communicate. It also teaches them to observe, interpret, create, and work alongside others, understanding that any collective production calls for commitment, responsibility, and respect.
intro.p3: We believe art is expression, encounter, cultural heritage, and a space of freedom. That is why, from the earliest years, we create opportunities for our students to discover themselves, get to know one another, communicate, create, and transform.
intro.p4Lead: Art is part of school life.
intro.p4: Through different languages and experiences, we support every student in finding their own way to express themselves and learning to recognise and value beauty in its many forms.

lenguajes.title: Artistic languages
lenguajes.p1: Our proposal brings together different artistic languages that connect with and enrich one another:
lenguajes.p2: These languages are part of the experience at every level and develop progressively according to the age, interests, and expressive possibilities of each student.

play.title: San Isidro Play
play.subtitle: A creation that brings the whole community together
play.p1: San Isidro Play is the moment when the different artistic languages worked on at school come together and come alive in a shared production.
play.p2: Each Concert is performed in English and built with the students taking part. The band plays the music live; others sing, act, or dance; some create the set design and contribute to the visual and expressive sides of the staging. Every student can find a leading place from which to bring their talents, ideas, and creativity.
play.p3: The project brings together Music, Singing, Drama, Dance, Body Expression, and Visual Arts in a process that calls for commitment, responsibility, and teamwork. At the same time, it offers a new opportunity to put English into practice in a real and meaningful context. Through rehearsals and the performance itself, students develop their speaking skills, enrich their vocabulary, and gain confidence communicating in their second language.
play.p4: Throughout the year, each level puts on its own Concerts, suited to the characteristics and possibilities of that stage. The show that is finally performed is the visible result of a journey of learning, creation, and collaboration.
play.p5: Beyond what happens on stage, San Isidro Play lets students discover new ways to express themselves, trust their own abilities, and experience the joy of building something valuable together.
play.closing: Because at San Isidro Play every contribution counts and everyone is part of the show.

intro.lead: A faith expressed in everyday life
intro.p1: San Isidro College is a place created to grow in healthy, deep bonds with people, with nature, with values, and with one's own spirituality, knowing ourselves loved by God.
intro.p2: Our Catholic orientation supports the integral education of our students and seeks to strengthen their human and spiritual growth. We work so they can become free people, able to discern, to choose the values that will guide their lives, and to commit themselves to the good of others.
intro.p3: This formation is built through everyday example, listening, and the close support of teachers, in close collaboration with families. Joy, trust, kindness, solidarity, and love for others are concrete expressions of the faith we want to pass on.

legado.p1: The figure of Saint Isidore the Labourer inspires our identity and the way we understand education. His simple life, his faith, his humility, his dedication to work, and his bond with the land remind us of the value of daily effort, the care of nature, and generous service to others.
legado.p2: These principles are not offered as words alone: we want them present in the relationships, the decisions, and the experiences that make up daily life at school.

servicio.title: Learning through service
servicio.p1: We believe solidarity is learned. Through volunteering and social commitment, students come close to different realities, learn to listen, and work alongside others. These experiences seek to awaken empathy, responsibility, and the awareness that every person can help transform their community. To serve is also to learn: it is discovering the value of encounter, recognising the other, and understanding that our talents take on a deeper meaning when they are placed at the service of others.

campanas.title: Solidarity campaigns
campanas.subtitle: Actions to support those who need it most.

intro.p1: San Isidro College, located in a privileged natural setting, develops a varied Physical Education program as part of the Pedagogical Project, which aims to contribute to shaping a life plan.
intro.p2: Physical Education represents much more than a curriculum area at our school. It becomes a fundamental discipline for the comprehensive education and formation of the human being, especially when implemented at an early age, as it allows children and adolescents to develop motor, cognitive, and affective skills essential for daily life and as part of a healthy lifestyle and social interaction. Through it, they express their spontaneity and learn to know, respect, and value themselves and others.
intro.p3: Therefore, it is essential to include and experience different activities in play, gymnastics, and sports, in order to implement them continuously, either in class or through educational projects. Creating a habit of physical activity allows students, beyond school, to feel healthy and active, incorporating these practices into their free time.

bienestar.title: Student Well-Being
bienestar.p1: At San Isidro College, we value the well-being of our students, considering it essential for their holistic development. We strive to create an environment where they feel safe, content, and happy—key factors for them to excel and achieve success.
bienestar.p2: We promote student well-being through a patient, positive, and proactive approach led by trained and experienced teachers, involving the entire educational community. Our educational system, based on diversity and the PSHE curriculum, is designed to focus on each student’s comprehensive well-being.
bienestar.p3: Tutors play a crucial role by getting to know each student and building a trusting relationship, providing both practical and emotional support. Our tutoring system aims to foster personal and social growth, instilling a sense of responsibility and health awareness. We monitor academic progress and encourage good study habits.
bienestar.p4: We encourage parents to communicate with tutors about any concern, no matter how small, related to their child’s health and well-being. Through an enriching environment, we help students thrive both academically and emotionally.
